notes: Control Fan focus fix. Choosing and adjusting are now separate: glide to a control and nothing changes while you aim; rest your thumb on a blade for a beat and it locks — a bright ring shows the grab — and from then until you lift, only that control can change, however far you slide. Passing over a neighbour on the way can no longer change it. Blades are also larger and solid with full-brightness values, so the controls read clearly against dark wallpaper.
